Field manual

Protect the palace and destroy Rataxes’s fortress in the northeast. Choose Story for more time to recover or Commander for stronger, faster assaults.

Supplies: provisioners collect physical caches and deliver to a supplied palace or home. Buildings connect within 360m. Enemy soldiers within 85m of a link cut it: isolated training runs at 25%. Clear raiders or build connecting homes. A provisioner’s Repair order costs 0.3 supplies per health.

Depot: hold the central depot with soldiers for 8 uncontested seconds. It grants 2 supplies per second and stops Basil’s reserve income. Destroy his Guard School to stop recruitment altogether. The reserve report is public convoy intelligence.

Army: guards hold ground; scouts move quickly and see farther; field artillery outranges towers and deals 80% extra damage to buildings. Protect artillery with guards. Sandbag cover reduces incoming damage by 35% for either faction.

Morale: hits suppress units; below 25 they withdraw automatically. After 3 seconds without fire, morale recovers by 4/s, 12/s near a commander, or 10/s at an aid station. Below 45, movement and firing slow. Retreat moves 20% faster and avoids engagement.

Recovery: linked homes and palaces heal nearby units by 2/s after 5 seconds without fire; Celeste raises this to 6/s. Commanders recover for 45 seconds, then return when 100 supplies are available. Periwinkle reduces the wait to 25 seconds.

Orders: drag to select; Shift adds units; right-click moves or focuses a visible enemy. A selects attack-move, M move, G gather, E repair, S hold, R retreat. F2 selects the army; H returns to the palace. Space pauses. Touch uses the same explicit order buttons and Pan map. Scroll or +/− zooms. Family & council pauses the simulation; closing it restores the previous pause state.
